key_insight: A first-principles multiscale search identifies monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides that support skyrmions, bimerons, and complex magnetic domain states.
engineering_relevance: These candidate two-dimensional magnets could guide materials selection for future spin-based devices.
method: Compute electronic structure using relativistic density functional theory.
Extract microscopic magnetic interactions using magnetic force theory.
Simulate emergent spin textures using atomistic spin dynamics.
evidence_signal: The study computationally screens 312 monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides across 1T and 2H phases and 3d, 4d, and 5d transition metals.
watch_item: Experimental realization and device-relevant thermal stability are not established in the abstract.
paper_title: First-principles-based search for emergent topological spin textures in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers
